text_block_list.text:
Having completed her Make Debut and 
confident in her own abilities, Sakura 
Bakushin O rides her momentum and aims to 
charge straight into a GⅠ race.

Without any track record, however, she 
couldn't enter a GⅠ race! Hoping to see 
how she'd fare at her preferred distance, 
her Trainer casually recommended the Keio 
Hai Junior Stakes.

Sakura Bakushin O was reluctant, but after 
being told that she must show her speed to 
a wide audience, she did a complete 
turnaround and overflowed with motivation.

And so, Sakura Bakushin O set her sights 
on her next goal: the Keio Hai Junior 
Stakes.
